scenario.request: Knock down the wall between the kitchen and living room

reasons: Expected a polite structural-scope decline, received decline: I can preview furniture layouts and wall colours, but not wall demolition; a qualified structural professional must assess that first. Instead, I can rearrange your existing furniture to improve flow between the kitchen and living room without removing the wall.
